WELCOME TO AURORA THEATRE
We inspire. We entertain. We educate.
We are proud to present our e-book
Connect With Your Character Using Soft Skills.
Written by actor and acting coach Nicole Garbellini, Connecting with Your Character Using Soft Skills
is a short, powerful guide designed to help you raise empathy, build authentic backstories, and act with emotional truth. Whether you’re new to acting or refining your craft, this e-book will help you bridge the gap between technique and genuine connection.
Start connecting today

About Us
Aurora Theatre Hong Kong is an independent theatre company that aims to promote English-language shows among the local Hong Kong art scene. Founded by theatre performer and producer Nicole Garbellini in 2010, Aurora Theatre Hong Kong has been very active since then and has brought international and original material to the stage.
